title: Eglin Daily 008 — UKG correction; Anthropic Agent SDK billing on 6/15; EU-PTD at T-3
summary: Self-correction: yesterday's brief framed UKG as the open HR-giant variable, but UKG/Google Cloud's agentic-AI partnership is from 2025-10-09, the Gemini Agent Gallery launch landed 2026-04-29, and UKG Pro Pay with Workforce AI shipped 2026-05-11. All four enterprise-HR giants (SAP, Oracle, Workday, UKG) are already inside agentic-hiring coalitions — the consolidation is eight months done, not three months away. Helm should strike the 'UKG is the open variable' line from the next-Briefing draft by 2026-06-06; Compass updates the prospect-deck timing claim within a week. Second elevated signal: Anthropic moves the Claude Agent SDK, claude -p, Claude Code GitHub Actions, and third-party agents to a separate independently-billed credit pool effective 2026-06-15 (T-11 days) — Forge audits swarm and customer agent-call paths by 6/12; Kernel confirms the eval-set runner has an explicit usage-credits fallback. Third: EU-PTD now T-3 days with the EC's no-extension stance reconfirmed; Slovakia and Italy transposed, Netherlands and Denmark publicly slipped to 2027-01-01, the remaining 22 indeterminate. Post-deadline post-mortem from Compass on 6/8; per-jurisdiction tracker from Forge by 6/30.
